mined_task_summaries: bug_repair: A server-side outbound request guard validates the initial hostname before fetching but does not re-check the destination on each redirect hop, so a redirect chain from an approved host to a private address bypasses the check

bug_repair: When an upstream model proxy returns a transient error code, the client treats it as a permanent failure instead of retrying with exponential backoff and falling back to a non-streaming request

bug_repair: A cached negative authentication response for a preview embed continues to deny access even after the user's session has been successfully refreshed, causing the preview to stay blank on reload

bug_repair: The remix operation checks the caller's project count against the lifetime row limit instead of the active project limit, allowing a user already at their active project quota to keep remixing published apps up to the higher row ceiling

bug_repair: When the cleanup helper called during a hard delete throws, the delete handler returns a success response but the backing stateful compute object remains alive and counts against the user's hosting quota
bug_repair: A sync message with a replace-all flag and an empty files map causes the agent to execute a full project delete followed by zero inserts, erasing the workspace without warning

bug_repair: When a generation is aborted, the write epoch is bumped before broadcasting the interrupt event to connected clients, so a stale generation's in-flight writes can still land after the abort

bug_repair: When the server sends a generation-interrupted event, the client-side chat component does not clear its in-progress generation state, leaving the composer locked until the page is reloaded

bug_repair: A server-side route that triggers a project remix export does not inject the authenticated user's identity into the outbound request, causing the downstream handler to reject it with an authorization error

bug_repair: Tool invocation markup from the model's raw output is not stripped before writing the assistant turn to the user-visible chat history, so technical tags appear as literal text in the conversation
bug_repair: The preview pane's reload button is disabled whenever the preview is showing an error, which prevents the user from manually retrying the load after a transient failure

bug_repair: The dashboard page component calls the native fetch function directly instead of the session-authenticated wrapper, causing requests to fail with authorization errors when the session token is not a cookie

bug_repair: An in-memory repair-pending flag is cleared whenever the stateful compute object hibernates, so a queued completeness repair that was recorded before hibernation is never executed after the object wakes

bug_repair: Rapid consecutive prompt submissions can bypass the busy lock check and start two concurrent generations on the same project, leaving the workspace in a mixed state from interleaved file writes
bug_repair: An ephemeral project created during a model benchmark run is not deleted when the run completes or fails, causing the test user's project count to grow with each benchmark execution

bug_repair: A short-lived in-memory cache for the public gallery listing is not cleared when a project is published, unpublished, or deleted, so the gallery can show stale entries for up to the cache duration
bug_repair: When a project is deleted, the hosting slot it occupies is not released until a background sweep runs, so the user's active hosting count remains inflated until the sweep fires

bug_repair: A runtime maintenance endpoint accepts and partially processes a malformed request body instead of refusing it immediately, risking partial state changes from a corrupted or replayed sweep payload

bug_repair: A timer that aborts a generation when a client disconnects is not cancelled when the same client reconnects, so the timer can fire at the next disconnect even though no generation is running

bug_repair: A test that verifies a stalled stream is aborted advances time by the full generation ceiling instead of the smaller first-chunk deadline, making the test pass for the wrong reason and masking a mismatch between the two timeout values

bug_repair: An automated repair loop replaces a dependency version with a different one, then a subsequent repair round reverts to the original version, causing an infinite alternation that exhausts the repair budget without resolving the underlying error
bug_repair: After a client-side build update, a missing chunk triggers a 404 that the browser caches, so subsequent page loads continue to fail even after the correct chunk is available

bug_repair: A preview rendered inside the operator admin panel shares the same origin as the admin interface, allowing a malicious generated app to access admin cookies and make authenticated requests on behalf of the operator

bug_repair: The error classifier for generation failures returns different category values for the same underlying status code when called multiple times with the same input, making retry decisions non-deterministic

bug_repair: When generation fails with an unexpected error, the raw exception message including internal stack frames and provider-specific codes is returned to the client instead of a plain-language explanation

bug_repair: Overly conservative per-turn output limits cause the generation to stop mid-file on every multi-file app, triggering unnecessary truncation retries that consume budget and reduce the fraction of generations that complete successfully

bug_repair: The post-generation import checker reports a missing module for a transitive re-export that is already resolved through another path, triggering a repair pass that generates duplicate file content

net_new: Replace the offset-based gallery listing query with cursor-based keyset pagination so large public galleries can be fetched incrementally without inconsistent results from concurrent publish changes
net_new: Allow a project owner to register an endpoint that receives a signed payload when a generation completes or fails, enabling downstream automation without polling the project status
net_new: Provide an endpoint that returns a paginated, downloadable record of all generations for an account including the model used, token counts, and outcome for each run

net_new: Expose an endpoint and a workspace panel that shows cumulative token consumption, model call counts, and daily budget remaining so users understand how much of their allowance a project has consumed

net_new: Track cumulative project file storage per user and emit a workspace warning when the total approaches the per-file byte cap, giving the user a chance to remove unused assets before generation fails
net_new: Allow a user to apply a diff between the current workspace state and a named source checkpoint, restoring only the files that changed rather than replacing every file in the project
net_new: Add an endpoint that packages all projects owned by a user into a single downloadable archive, enabling full account backup without requiring individual per-project zip exports
net_new: Allow a user to submit the same prompt against two configured models and view the resulting files side by side, with a diff highlighting where the outputs diverge
net_new: Before a custom domain is accepted and routed to a hosted project, verify ownership by checking for a record that only the domain holder can set, preventing domain hijacking between accounts
net_new: Add an account endpoint that lists all active sessions with their creation time and last-used timestamp, and allows the user to invalidate any session except the current one
net_new: Collect content security policy violation reports from preview iframes and surface them as structured diagnostics in the workspace console so developers can debug blocked resource loads

net_new: Periodically ping each configured external tool server and record availability so the workspace can warn when a configured capability is unreachable before the user starts a generation that depends on it

net_new: Enforce a per-project generation request rate limit that is stored in the stateful compute object and persists across isolate restarts, replacing the current isolate-local counter that allows abuse after eviction
net_new: Add a scoring column to the gallery project table that weights recent remix and view counts so the gallery can be sorted by engagement rather than only by publication date

net_new: Before a generation starts, analyse the prompt and the current workspace to produce a list of files likely to be created or changed, letting the user confirm destructive operations before any writes occur

net_new: After a generation completes, show the approximate token count contributed by each written file so users can identify which files consume the most context budget and trim them before the next run
net_new: Before applying a schema migration to a hosted project's database, capture a named snapshot of the current data so the user can restore the previous state if the migration produces errors

net_new: Expose an operator endpoint that sends a minimal probe request to a configured custom model and returns its response time and status, making it easy to verify a newly configured endpoint before using it in production
net_new: Allow a project owner to invite a collaborator with a read-only role that can view the workspace and preview but cannot trigger generations or modify files
net_new: Allow a user to select two saved source checkpoints and view a file-level diff showing which files were added, removed, or changed between them, with per-file line-level diffs on demand
net_new: Capture console output emitted by code running inside a sandboxed preview frame and display it in the workspace project console alongside the build and server output

net_new: Collect per-stage elapsed times for each generation and expose them in a workspace panel as a timeline, helping users and operators understand where time is spent across the model call, extraction, and verification stages
net_new: Allow a logged-in user to fork any published gallery project into a new workspace with a single action, copying all source files but starting with a clean generation history

repo_evolution: Replace the fixed-window counter in the rate limiter with a sliding-window algorithm so a burst of requests at the boundary of two windows cannot momentarily exceed double the configured limit
repo_evolution: Rewrite the project list query to use a keyset cursor instead of a row offset so the results remain stable as projects are added or deleted between pages

repo_evolution: Pull the versioned schema migration logic out of the durable object implementation and into a reusable module so both the agent object and the registry object share one migration runner rather than duplicating the pattern

repo_evolution: Define a single typed error envelope and route every error path in the worker through it so clients always receive a consistent shape with a code, message, and optional detail, eliminating the current mix of formats

repo_evolution: Move all generation-specific state and logic from the monolithic stateful compute object into a dedicated pipeline class so the object's responsibility is limited to connection lifecycle and project management

repo_evolution: Replace the sequential series of independent if-blocks in the request authentication path with a composable chain of middleware functions each responsible for exactly one check, making the order explicit and new checks easy to add

repo_evolution: Consolidate the preview sandbox attribute string and the feature permission list into one shared location so every render site that creates a preview frame is guaranteed to use identical security settings

repo_evolution: Replace the convention of matching a string type field in incoming messages with a discriminated union type so the compiler enforces exhaustive handling and unknown message types are caught at compile time

repo_evolution: Store project files by the hash of their content rather than by path so unchanged files across generations are not re-stored, reducing storage growth for projects that make incremental edits

repo_evolution: Extract the inline email body building logic into a separate function so the rendering can be tested independently of the delivery network call and different templates can be composed without duplication

repo_evolution: Consolidate the duplicate shrinkage detection logic that currently exists separately in the structured tool handler and the text-protocol file extractor into a single shared function so a fix or threshold change applies everywhere
repo_evolution: Replace the compile-time static model list with a configuration stored in the registry object so an operator can enable or disable models without redeploying the worker

repo_evolution: Define all structured log field names and their types as a shared schema object so callers cannot mistype a field key and query tooling can introspect the log shape without reading every call site

repo_evolution: Change the rate limiter from holding its window state in a module-level map to instance state so multiple limiters running in the same module do not share their counters and tests can create isolated instances

repo_evolution: Split the large single fetch handler in the edge worker into individually tested per-route handler modules so each route can be tested in isolation without constructing the full worker environment

repo_evolution: Replace the current approximation that divides character count by a fixed ratio with a real tokenizer so context window budget calculations are accurate enough to prevent silent truncation on codebases with many short identifiers

repo_evolution: Move the scattered checks that decide which project files are safe to serve to a preview frame into a single authoritative function so a change to the visibility rules takes effect on every path simultaneously

repo_evolution: Separate the client-side logic that shows a resume suggestion banner from the generation job state machine so the banner can be tested and modified independently without risk of accidentally affecting how jobs are tracked

repo_evolution: Replace the simple recency sort for the public gallery with a composite score that combines publication date, remix count, and view count so recently active projects outrank old ones with no engagement

repo_evolution: Remove the legacy fallback that reads project files and messages from browser local storage when the primary indexed storage is unavailable, since the storage layer now detects unavailability explicitly and surfaces an error

repo_evolution: Replace the hardcoded admin email list in the deployment configuration file with a runtime secret so the list can be updated without a new deployment and does not appear in the versioned configuration

repo_evolution: Replace scattered numeric literals for project caps, generation limits, and hosting slots with named constants from a single shared module so all enforcement points are guaranteed to compare against the same value

agentic: Extend the server-side fetch guard to resolve a hostname to its address before fetching and range-check the resolved result against private and reserved ranges, closing the rebinding attack vector described in the existing implementation comments

agentic: Split a large project export operation into progress-tracked chunks that can be resumed after a timeout, recording which files have been committed so a retry starts from the last successful batch rather than the beginning

agentic: Instrument each stage of the generation pipeline with a shared trace identifier so the model call, file extraction, post-generation checks, and repair turns can all be correlated in logs without parsing timestamps

agentic: Hash the complete set of input files before a build and cache the resulting build artifact by that hash so an identical set of files reuses the previous build output without re-running the transpiler

agentic: Record the complete input state for each generation and allow an operator to re-run any past generation against a different model, then view a file-level diff comparing the two outputs to evaluate model quality

agentic: Allow a user to merge the file tree from a saved checkpoint into the current workspace, detecting conflicts where both the checkpoint and the live tree changed the same file and presenting each conflict for manual resolution

agentic: After a successful preview build, run an automated accessibility check against the live preview and report failures as structured diagnostics in the workspace console with line-level references to the generated source

agentic: Replace the current heuristic file ranking with an embedding-based relevance scorer that orders workspace files by similarity to the current prompt, ensuring the most relevant files always fit within the context budget

agentic: When a post-generation check identifies a specific failing invariant, generate a minimal repair prompt that targets only the failing files rather than re-running the full generation, reducing repair token cost

agentic: Define a registration interface for post-generation checks so new validators can be added as independent modules without modifying the core pipeline, and the pipeline combines any subset of failing checks into a single repair turn

agentic: Decompose a complex app generation into independent frontend and backend subtasks dispatched to parallel sub-agents, then merge their outputs with conflict detection before committing the combined file set to the project

agentic: After a generation completes, use the project description and verification plan to synthesize browser-automation test cases, execute them against the live preview, and report failures back into the repair loop

agentic: Before applying a new schema migration to a hosted project database, analyse the existing tables to detect column type conflicts, missing foreign key targets, and incompatible data that would cause the migration to fail mid-run

agentic: Before starting a generation, analyse the prompt complexity and workspace file count to estimate the number of output tokens and wall-clock time required, showing the user a cost estimate and letting them choose a smaller model

agentic: Push each completed file to the preview iframe incrementally as the generation streams rather than waiting for the full generation to finish, so users see partial results immediately and can cancel earlier if the direction is wrong

bug_repair: The in-memory store that prevents duplicate generation requests from executing twice accumulates entries for the lifetime of the stateful object without any eviction policy, causing memory to grow unbounded on long-lived objects

bug_repair: The cached kill-switch status uses a fixed storage key regardless of which model is being queried, so disabling one model can incorrectly block or unblock a different model that was cached under the same key

bug_repair: When all capacity ladder steps are rejected for context-length reasons, the generation fails with a generic error rather than a clear user message explaining that the workspace exceeds the maximum context size for this model

bug_repair: The guard that prevents the model from rewriting certain config files blocks a package manifest rewrite even when the build error context clearly references a dependency problem that requires updating that file

net_new: Add a workspace command that searches the full text of all files in the current project and returns matching lines with file and line references, enabling navigation in large generated codebases

net_new: Set up a recurring scheduled task that probes each enabled model with a minimal request and records the outcome so the operator dashboard can show current availability without waiting for a real user generation to fail
net_new: Expose a per-project timeline of recorded events including generations, publishes, checkpoint saves, and schema migrations ordered by time so a user can reconstruct what changed and when

net_new: Extend the prompt classifier test suite to cover boundary cases where a destructive-looking prompt is actually a targeted edit, an ambiguous single-word prompt, and a multi-sentence prompt where only one clause names a build target

net_new: Provide a workspace action that generates a project overview document from the current file tree, describing the entry points, data models, and external integrations without requiring the user to write anything

net_new: Record bounced and complained-about email addresses in the registry and suppress future delivery attempts to those addresses to prevent continued delivery failures that damage sending reputation

net_new: Record which capability tools are invoked during each generation and at what frequency so the operator can see which external services are used most, identify failing tool integrations, and prioritize reliability work

repo_evolution: Merge the separate start and reserve calls on the spending ledger into a single atomic transaction so a lease can never be created without also recording the corresponding token reservation, eliminating the race between the two steps

net_new: Split the system prompt into a static prefix that never changes within a model variant and a dynamic suffix that contains per-turn state, then mark the static prefix for provider-side caching to reduce input token costs on repeated calls

net_new: Run all post-generation validators concurrently rather than sequentially and combine any failures into a single repair prompt so the repair overhead scales with the number of failures rather than their count times the latency of each check

net_new: Record which files were successfully written during an in-flight generation and, when the stream dies mid-way, offer the user a resume prompt that tells the model which files already exist so only the missing ones need to be regenerated

net_new: After each generation, compare every route invocation in the frontend source against the handler list in the backend worker and queue a targeted repair turn for any fetch call that has no matching handler

net_new: Move email delivery off the synchronous request path by pushing each outbound message to a durable queue so a transient delivery failure retries automatically without the user-facing request timing out
net_new: Embed each published project's name and description into a vector index and expose a search endpoint that returns the most semantically similar projects to a natural-language query

net_new: Emit a structured analytics event for each completed generation recording the model, output token count, first-response latency, and terminal status so generation quality and cost trends can be tracked over time
net_new: Require a verified challenge token on sign-up and login endpoints to prevent automated account creation and credential stuffing attacks without adding friction for legitimate users

repo_evolution: Replace two separate round-trips to the budget registry with a single combined call so the network latency for starting a generation is halved and the window for the lease to expire between the two calls is eliminated

net_new: Enforce a per-minute limit on the number of live file update events the development server can push to the preview so a runaway file watcher cannot saturate the websocket and overwhelm the client

net_new: Add a maximum active lifetime and a crash restart counter to the development job so a hung or repeatedly crashing server process is forcibly terminated rather than consuming resources indefinitely

net_new: Cache a verified session record in a fast key-value store with a short expiry so subsequent authenticated requests on the same session skip the registry lookup entirely, reducing per-request latency

bug_repair: When a single-use preview ticket expires, the embed frame receives a machine-readable error response that the browser still treats as a successful document load, triggering the frame's load event and hiding the retry prompt from the parent page

bug_repair: When the same search text appears more than once in a file, the edit tool applies the replacement to the first occurrence without warning, silently producing incorrect output instead of requiring the caller to provide more context

net_new: Selectively inject the subset of workspace files most relevant to the current prompt into the system prompt context rather than all files, using a scoring function to rank relevance so the most useful files fit when context is limited

net_new: Transform module source for the live preview by stripping markdown fences, mapping incorrect icon library names to their correct equivalents, and rewriting import paths so the preview resolves modules correctly

net_new: Parse the raw output of failed build commands to extract the actionable error lines from the surrounding noise, returning a structured object that names the real cause such as a missing dependency, a type error, or an unresolved import

net_new: Automatically start a development backend process when the user's project contains a server entry point, push updated files to it on each save, and restart it after a crash up to a configurable limit

net_new: Record the outcome of every generation attempt per model and expose a reliability score in the admin panel so the operator can identify which models are producing successful generations and which are failing at high rates
